title: WPSS/584/2015 of Harpal Singh Yadav Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No. 584 of 2017
U.C.Dhyani, J.
 Mr. Dinesh Gahatori, Advocate, holding brief
of Mr. Sushil Vashisth, present for the petitioner.
 Mr. C. S. Rawat, Additional Chief Standing
Counsel, present for the State.
 By means of present writ petition, the
petitioner seeks the following prayers, among
others:
(a) Issue a writ, direction or order in the nature of
mandamus commanding the respondents to release
the entire arrear of salary including the difference
of revised pay and arrear of bonus to the petitioner
since 1998.
(b) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of
mandamus commanding the respondents not to
interfere in the discharging of peaceful service of
petitioner and not to restrain petitioner from
putting his signature in attendance register.
 When the writ petition was taken up on
09.11.2017, following order was passed:
"Learned Standing Counsel has apprised the
Court that Deputy Education Officer,
Bahadrabad has raised a demand for
allocation of budget from District Education
Officer (Basic Education), when the budget is
received by it, the arrears of the petitioners
shall be paid."
 It is the submission of learned counsel for the
State that budget is awaited. He reiterates the above
noted submission and says that arrears of salary and
pension, as admitted to the respondents, shall be paid
to the petitioner no sooner the budget is allocated/
funds are released to the Deputy Education Officer,
Bahadrabad.
 Learned counsel for the petitioner confined his
prayer only to the extent, as above.
 The Court records the aforesaid statements of
learned counsel for the parties and disposes of the
writ petition by directing respondents no. 2 to 5 to
release the pension and arrears of salary to the
petitioner, as admitted to them within eight weeks
from today.
 (U.C.Dhyani, J.)
 04.12.2017 Kaushal
